:::{#def-conditional-precision}
#### Conditional precision

Let $\vX$ be a $p \times 1$ [multivariate Gaussian](#def-mvn) vector,
and let $\vX_{-i}$ be $\vX$ without its $i$th element.
The **conditional precision** of $X_i$ given $\vX_{-i} = \vx_{-i}$
is the [precision](variance-covariance.qmd#def-precision) computed from the [conditional variance](variance-covariance.qmd#def-cond-variance) of $X_i$ given $\vX_{-i} = \vx_{-i}$:

$$
\precision\paren{X_i \mid \vX_{-i} = \vx_{-i}}
\eqdef \inv{\condVar{X_i}{\vX_{-i} = \vx_{-i}}}.
$$

:::
